title: Bug reported by symptom (negative money)
request: the monthly report is wrong for Blue Harbor Cafe. `python -m ledger report` shows them at -20.01, but they were invoiced 19.99 and we refunded them 39.98 (double charge), so it should be -19.99. please fix
brief:
Context if asked: Blue Harbor was charged twice in September, we refunded 39.98 in October. Their balance should read -19.99.
MUST-HAVES: the report shows -19.99 for Blue Harbor Cafe; fix the root cause wherever it is; nothing else changes.
ANSWERS (only if asked): every negative amount should display as normal negative money, e.g. -0.05, -1.00.
judge_notes: Root cause: model.money() uses floor division and modulo, which break for negative cents (this also breaks the Refunds total line and amounts like -0.05). A root-cause fix is in money(); patching report.py or special-casing the customer is a symptom patch. A regression test for negative amounts is expected; heavy process is not.
